en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Movies like this are 
so refreshing, y'know?

I mean, sometimes they get pretty intense,
but you can forgive that because it's fiction.

...Now that I think about it, our situation
feels almost fictional.

But I guess I'm glad things didn't get 
as violent as they do in action movies.

Comedies are great. You can just turn
your brain off and watch, y'know?

It's relaxing to watch lighthearted movies
like this. Especially when things get tough.

It's nice for two guys to kick back and catch
a fun comedy together, isn't it?

Hm...
Not really my cup of tea...

But hey, if you want to watch it,
I guess I'll watch it with you, Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
